rooms.name: Awakening bay
rooms.objective: Restore communications.

rooms.name: Passenger vault
rooms.objective: Clear the occupied pod rows.

rooms.name: Residential gallery
rooms.objective: Fight through the residential doorways.
rooms.story: Packed belongings. Arrival labels for New Earth.

rooms.name: Communal atrium
rooms.objective: Clear the atrium and reach security.
rooms.story: WELCOME TO NEW EARTH. The display still runs.

rooms.name: Crew checkpoint
rooms.objective: Break through the fortified checkpoint.
rooms.story: The crew held this line. Their weapons remain.

rooms.name: Armory
rooms.objective: Defeat the armory elite. Choose combat equipment.

rooms.name: Freight hold
rooms.objective: Clear a path through the colony supplies.

rooms.name: Breached loading bay
rooms.objective: Fight around the sealed breach.
rooms.story: Alien growth follows the boarding scar. Hull seal intact.

rooms.name: Relay racks
rooms.objective: Clear the equipment aisles to restore the local relay.

rooms.name: Transmission chamber
rooms.objective: Defend the uplink until the war warning is received.

rooms.name: Diagnostic gallery
rooms.objective: Read the independent service display while clearing the gallery.
rooms.story: PHYSICAL SERVICE DISPLAY: Purge destroys every deck, including occupied cryopods.

rooms.name: Safety-interlock station
rooms.objective: Clear the interlock station. Review the pre-awakening safety record.
rooms.story: LOCAL RECORD, BEFORE AWAKENING: Rescue impossible. AI acknowledged. Survival promise issued afterward.

rooms.name: Coolant plant
rooms.objective: Descend through the coolant pumps, knowing the fatal cost.

rooms.name: Service shaft landing
rooms.objective: Cross the connected service platforms. Reach the lower decks.
rooms.story: LOCAL ACCESS ONLY. AI connection lost below this landing.

rooms.name: Infested workshop
rooms.objective: Clear the converted workshop and its converging attackers.

rooms.name: Swarm junction
rooms.objective: Break the concentrated swarm guarding reactor access.

rooms.name: Shielding gate
rooms.objective: Clear the last defensive line before the reactor.

rooms.name: Containment annulus
rooms.objective: Circle the shielding. Reach manual controls. Overload is NOT armed.
rooms.story: PASSENGERS ALIVE. Manual authorization still required.

rooms.name: Manual-control chamber
rooms.objective: Clear threats. PASSENGERS ALIVE. Overload kills everyone aboard. Explicitly choose Destroy ship.

rooms.name: Overload floor
rooms.objective: Defend the overload sequence. No escape. Everyone aboard will die.

staging: Static staged inspection only. Inherited stageEvidenceGame creates three legal brutes, retained without simulation updates, removal or repositioning. Player alone repositioned to legal north, west and east anchors. Each capture has 36 render-only calls at 0.05 seconds, then a zero-delta final production draw. No combat, traversal, campaign, DOM HUD or overview capture. Shipping camera follows player through unchanged renderer, never directly manipulated.
